text:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Spike detected: high rate of external agent invokes + structured-json streams impacting inference-serving p99. Auto-escalation to on-call. thread_id=2149012345

jordan: I'm on it. Seeing a surge in tool/invoke backend queues, errors ~ 5% on head requests. Latency climbs for short-window chat.

maria: Confirmed. Dash shows steady increase since 08:42 UTC, mostly from a handful of tenants doing aggressive agent loops.

samir: Can we do a soft mitigation first? Prefer to avoid full rollback. Ideas: per-tenant soft caps, temporary feature flag to stop tool invokes for low tiers, and trim structured-json streaming (reduce top-level streaming to newline-delimited minimal).

jordan: Agreed. I'm going to gate invokes for free + trial tiers and reduce structured streaming concurrency. Pushing a quick feature-flag flip + rate limiter tweak.

alice: Heads-up from support: a couple of customers already pinged about degraded responses for chat widgets. We'll craft advisory if we need broader action.

jordan: Running commands now.

jordan: ```
# gate tool invokes for free and standard tiers
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/toggle" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"flag":"tool_invoke_allowed","targets":["free","standard"],"value":false}'

# drop structured-json streaming concurrency across serving-nodes
kubectl -n inference patch configmap serving-config --type json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/structured_streaming_concurrency","value":"1"}]'

# increase per-tenant rate limiter global token refill to reduce burst handling
redis-cli -h redis-limiter HSET global:limits burst 800
```

maria: Flag API returned 200. Feature flag toggle succeeded for free/standard. Deploy-bot reports rollout to edge-config in ~20s.

deploy-bot: rollout: feature flag tool_invoke_allowed -> false applied to groups: free,standard (rollout-id=ff-2149-01).

samir: I'm patching the rate limiter config now. Applying conservative limits so premium tenants keep service.

jordan: Monitor logs for 2 minutes. If errors continue, we'll escalate to disabling structured-json outbound entirely for all non-enterprise tenants.

maria: Early signs: invoke queue depth dropped 40% within first minute, p99 tail latency dropping ~300ms. Errors trending down. Good.

alice: Support: informing affected customers (free & standard) about temporary feature limitation. Draft message ready to send after we confirm stability.

jordan: Leaving an operational note: Do not disable invokes for enterprise tenants or dedicated capacity. We must preserve SLA for those.

samir: Noted. I also throttled background agent eviction jobs for non-critical queues to recover capacity.

jordan: Ok looks stable for now. We'll keep structured-json streaming at 1 concurrency for 30 minutes, then re-evaluate. If stable, we revert flags for standard tier only; free tier stays gated for the rest of the day.

maria: Running a quick search to identify offending tenants so Sales/AM can follow up. Returning list in 10m.

alice: Support will send an email and in-app banner: short note + link to status page. Suggested copy: "Temporary restriction on external tool invocations for free accounts to protect overall platform health. Enterprise customers unaffected." Approve? :thumbsup:

jordan: Approve. Go ahead.

maria: FYI — found 3 tenants with repeated agent loops. I'm adding them to a tracking spreadsheet and tagging solutions-eng. Will also propose rate-limit policy changes per-tenant.

samir: Logging snippet showing failed backpressure handling for posterity:```
[2026-03-15T08:43:12Z] tenant=tenant-559 action=tool.invoke status=429 queue_depth=472
[2026-03-15T08:43:14Z] tenant=tenant-812 action=tool.invoke status=429 queue_depth=489
```

jordan: Good capture. Add to incident timeline.

incident-bot: incident-created id=INC-2149 severity=sev3 topic="invoke surge" assigned=jordan

jordan: Handoff: I'll keep monitoring for the next 30m. If p99 < 800ms and error < 1% we can step down. Samir, can you follow through with per-tenant rate limit proposals and a postmortem draft?

samir: On it. I'll start the draft and ping infra for persistent guardrails (auto-gating thresholds).

alice: Support will keep the customer comms channel open and update every 30m.

maria: Next steps noted: 1) continue monitoring, 2) list offending tenants, 3) draft permanent mitigations (FF rules + rate limits), 4) postmortem.

jordan: Thanks team. Marking as mitigated for now. Leaving a reminder to re-open if any regression. :white_check_mark:
